label: Walks and scores
subgoals: Start each walk on a surface enclosing the source conductor
Record the walk's score when it lands on the target conductor
Average the scores to estimate the capacitance

label: The standard error
subgoals: Estimate the per-walk standard deviation from the samples
Divide it by the square root of the walk count
Express the standard error as a fraction of the mean

label: Walks needed for a target
subgoals: Set the allowed standard error from the relative target
Solve for the walk count from the standard-error formula
Round the walk count up to an integer
